args.name: Grand Canyon poster roadside billboard with Golden Gate Bridge

style.prompt: Create a realistic landscape 16:9 roadside billboard mockup for a LinkedIn post using both supplied images. Image 1 is the finished Grand Canyon travel poster: preserve the entire original poster design exactly, including every letter, artwork, original colors, texture, borders, proportions and layout. Do not rewrite, redesign, stylize, crop or add anything to the poster. Image 2 is the Golden Gate Bridge background reference. Place a large portrait-format roadside advertising billboard in the foreground left, with the recognizable red Golden Gate Bridge towers, cables, roadway, blue sky and coastal hills visible behind it to the right, using the second photo as the scene reference. Billboard display is a flat vertical rectangle facing the camera almost perfectly straight-on, no perspective distortion, with the original full portrait poster filling it at its original aspect ratio, protected by a thin simple dark metal frame and supported by realistic metal posts beside the road. Poster occupies roughly 85 percent of image height, large enough for its original bottom lettering to remain readable. The bridge remains clearly visible on the right without overlapping the poster. Natural daytime photography, realistic grounding, crisp detail, clean professional composition, no extra words, no logos, no watermarks. Highest priority: retain the supplied poster as an unchanged printed image, particularly GRAND CANYON NATIONAL PARK and all original small lettering.
